name: MiniMax Speech
positioning: MiniMax Speech is the text-to-speech API (speech-2.8 models) on MiniMax's international developer platform, alongside its language, video, image and music APIs, with voice cloning and voice design.

pricing.model: Pay-as-you-go per million characters by model (hd or turbo), identical for synchronous and asynchronous synthesis; separate per-voice fees for voice design and rapid cloning; an Audio Subscription sold in 'audio points' is also offered.
pricing.headline: speech-2.8-turbo is $60 per 1M characters and speech-2.8-hd is $100 per 1M characters (pay-as-you-go, sync and async).
pricing.headlineTier: speech-2.8-turbo, pay-as-you-go (lower-priced of the two current models); speech-2.8-hd is $100

tiers.name: speech-2.8-turbo (sync and async)
tiers.notes: Optimised for speed and cost; same capabilities as hd.

tiers.name: speech-2.8-hd (sync and async)
tiers.notes: Higher-quality model; async supports up to 1M characters per request.

tiers.name: Voice Design
tiers.notes: Charged on first use for synthesis; in-API preview synthesis billed at $60 per 1M characters.

tiers.name: Rapid Voice Cloning
tiers.notes: Charged when the cloned voice is first used for synthesis; preview characters billed at the preview model's rate.

tiers.name: Audio Subscription
tiers.unit: USD 5 / 30 / 99 / 249 / 999 per month (Starter to Business) for 100,000 / 300,000 / 1,100,000 / 3,300,000 / 20,000,000 audio points
tiers.notes: Monthly prices; 3-month (10% off) and yearly (20% off) options. The conversion from audio points to characters is not stated on the pages read, so no per-character figure is derived.

promotions: Audio Subscription discounts: 10% off 3-month and 20% off yearly prices on the subscription page; no end date stated.

voices.count: 332 entries in the vendor's System Voice ID List page (may include language variants); plus voices created by cloning or voice design
voices.languages: 40 languages including Chinese, Cantonese, English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi and others, with a language_boost option for minority languages and dialects
voices.customVoiceOrCloning: Rapid voice cloning from an uploaded sample and Voice Design from a text description, both via API; the clone endpoint doc says a cloned voice not used within 7 days is deleted.

compatibility.note: Speech uses MiniMax's own endpoint POST https://api.minimax.io/v1/t2a_v2 (api-uw.minimax.io recommended for US West) with a nested JSON body (model, text, voice_setting, audio_setting) and audio returned hex-encoded by default; no OpenAI /v1/audio/speech route is documented. MiniMax's LLM API has OpenAI-compatible routes, which is separate from speech.

limits.perRequestCharacters: Synchronous text-to-speech (HTTP and WebSocket): under 10,000 characters per request, streaming recommended above 3,000; asynchronous long TTS: up to 1,000,000 characters per request.
limits.concurrency: Rate-limits page lists 60 requests per minute for T2A (speech-2.8, 2.6 and 02 models), 60 RPM for voice cloning and 20 RPM for voice design; Audio Subscription plans list RPM of 10 (Starter), 50 (Standard), 200 (Pro), 500 (Scale) and 800 (Business).

compliance.note: No HIPAA, SOC 2 or GDPR statement was found on the API documentation or pricing pages read.

strengths.claim: Supports 40 languages with a language_boost option for minority languages and dialects, plus a large system voice list.
Offers HTTP streaming, a synchronous WebSocket and a bidirectional streaming WebSocket that accepts text at any granularity, aimed at piping LLM output into speech.
Asynchronous long-form TTS accepts up to 1,000,000 characters per request at the same per-character price as sync.
Provides Voice Design and rapid cloning through the API with per-voice pricing of $3 and $1.5, charged on first use.
Offers pause markers, interjection tags on speech-2.8 models, optional subtitles and a quality text-normalization mode.

limitations.claim: Synchronous requests are limited to under 10,000 characters and the documented T2A rate limit is 60 requests per minute.
A cloned voice that is not used within 7 days is deleted by the system.
Speech uses a proprietary request and response shape (nested settings, hex-encoded audio) rather than an OpenAI-style route.

stepsToMove: Create an API key on the MiniMax platform and send it as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'.

POST https://api.minimax.io/v1/t2a_v2 with JSON: model (speech-2.8-turbo or speech-2.8-hd), text (under 10,000 characters), stream (true or false), voice_setting {voice_id, speed, vol, pitch} and audio_setting {sample_rate, bitrate, format}.
Decode the response: audio is hex-encoded in data.audio by default (output_format selects hex or url); usage_characters reports billed characters.
For low-latency streaming use stream=true over HTTP, or the synchronous or bidirectional WebSocket endpoints.
Map voices to MiniMax voice_id values from the System Voice ID List or create custom ones through Voice Cloning and Voice Design.
Replace pauses with the <#x#> pause marker and note the 60 RPM default rate limit.

bestFor: Teams that need broad language coverage including Chinese and Cantonese, long-form async synthesis, and voice design or cloning, and who accept per-character pricing of $60 to $100 per million.
